//: Lighthouse CI over the static export (Issue #60). `staticDistDir` makes LHCI serve out/ itself, so no dev server and no auth are involved: what it audits is the logged-out shell of each route, which is exactly what a first-time visitor on a slow connection gets. Category scores on a shared runner move by a few points between runs, so they are asserted as warnings; the resource budgets below are deterministic and are the hard gate. Budgets are pinned above the current measured first-load (max /table at ~1.2 MB of JS) so the gate starts green.
